stories.title: Iran plans massive funeral for Supreme Leader Khamenei after war death
stories.summary: Iran is preparing a delayed, massive funeral for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. While the government stages it as a show of force, citizens remain deeply divided over his legacy.

stories.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are confirmed to be getting married at MSG tonight
stories.summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are expected to tie the knot Friday night. We'll tell you how things are looking around Madison Square Garden, the venue where the nuptials are set to take place.

stories.title: Venezuelan government's quake response is under fire
stories.summary: Venezuela's interim president defends the government's handling of the deadly earthquakes amid mounting criticism.

stories.title: The Parade of Presidents has been going since 1976. Meet the woman who keeps it going
stories.summary: On the main street of Cuba City, Wisc., there's a Parade of Presidents, with decorative shields for each President, begun as a bicentennial project in 1976. Donna Rogers keeps it all going.

stories.title: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz remains a powerful bargaining chip
stories.summary: Despite efforts by U.S. negotiators, Iran says it wants to charge a toll for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. It's yet another unresolved issue of the U.S.-Iran war.

stories.title: Remembering the American tradition of reckless abandon on the night before July Fourth
stories.summary: Bonfires were a regular part of life in early U.S. history. Before the wide adoption of municipal firework displays, these giant fires, some many stories high, were common.
